title: Launch risk orchestration: degradation scenarios, rollback runbooks, and comms templates for Q2 SDK
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Objective: Create an operational playbook and communication artifacts so SDK release sdk-2026.04 can be launched with clear rollback criteria, minimal customer disruption, and coordinated cross-team responses. Scope covers degradation detection thresholds, runbook steps for partial and full rollbacks, canned comms (internal, enterprise customers, public status), and post-incident follow-up templates.

Deliverables:
- Rollback runbook (partial feature toggles, tag-based release revert, infra fallback to runtime-1.18)
- Degradation scenarios matrix (latency, error-rate, throughput, memory pressure, KV cache miss spike) with detection thresholds and owners
- Incident comms templates: internal triage, customer-facing incident update, post-mortem summary, legal-approved text for regulated customers
- Release notes coordination checklist and final sign-off flow with Design/Docs/Legal/Sales/CS
- Automated gating guidance (monitoring alerts -> canary hold -> auto-fallback rules)

Approach and trade-offs:
- Prioritize automated detection and low-latency rollback paths for high-impact regressions (P0/P1). Manual rollback will remain for complex stateful migrations to avoid data loss.
- Keep public comms conservative; provide more detailed notes to impacted customers through CS/Sales with NDA-safe attachments if needed.
- Trade-off: deeper automation requires more time to QA (extra SRE cycles). We will implement minimal safe automation for initial launch and iterate post-launch.

Owners and stakeholders:
- PM (this ticket): Ethan Chou (assignee)
- SRE lead: Priya Nair (alert thresholds, automation)
- Runtime/ENG owner: Marcus Huang (rollback scripts, migration safety)
- Docs/Release notes: Lina Gomez (final notes + SDK doc updates)
- Legal & Compliance: Omar Rahman (approved external comms)
- Customer Success / Sales: Nora Patel (customer outreach)

Success criteria (pre-launch):
- Runbook drafted, reviewed, and signed off by SRE + ENG + Legal by 2026-03-15
- Monitoring alerts and canary metrics defined and tested in staging with samples from production traffic
- Release notes sign-off and one mock incident comms exercise completed with CS and Sales

Acceptance criteria (post-launch):
- No unplanned P0 user-impacting incidents in first 72 hours OR rollback executed per runbook within SLA window
- Post-incident report created for any incident, with action items assigned and release gating updated
acceptance_criteria: 1) Runbook reviewed and approved by SRE/ENG/Legal (email thread or doc sign-off). 2) Canary metrics and alert thresholds tested in staging and captured in runbook. 3) Templates for internal and customer comms stored in the release folder and linked in rollout checklist. 4) At least one tabletop exercise completed prior to go-no-go meeting.
